# Synthetic SMTP delivery of a spoofed message (MAIL FROM evil domain,
# From: boss@kiwi-test.invalid). Wire is CRLF.
S: 220 fake.kiwi-test.invalid ESMTP FakeKIWI
C: EHLO client.kiwi-test.invalid
S: 250-fake.kiwi-test.invalid
S: 250-AUTH PLAIN LOGIN
S: 250 SIZE 10485760
C: MAIL FROM:<crook@evil-test.invalid>
S: 250 2.1.0 Ok
C: RCPT TO:<bob@kiwi-test.invalid>
S: 250 2.1.5 Ok
C: DATA
S: 354 End data with <CR><LF>.<CR><LF>
C: From: boss@kiwi-test.invalid
C: To: bob@kiwi-test.invalid
C: Subject: synthetic spoof
C:
C: Please ignore this synthetic phish.
C: .
S: 250 2.0.0 Ok: queued as FAKE0009
C: QUIT
S: 221 2.0.0 Bye
# Expected mock-DNS verdicts (see tests/mailauth-mapping.md):
#   SPF pass  (envelope crook@evil-test.invalid authorized by evil SPF)
#   DKIM none (no signature on the message)
#   DMARC fail, policy reject (From: boss@kiwi-test.invalid unaligned)
